messages:
lex: FYI kicking off an entitlement tidy this week focused on admin-role creep and unlabeled KMS/CMS keys. proposal: staged de-escalation (reclaim -> amber -> red) instead of immediate quarantine. quick ack and owner volunteers pls.

harper: ack. what are the stages?

lex: short: (1) reclaim (72h self-attest) -> add label `access:reclaim` and send email with form; (2) amber (if no response) -> disable console & mark `access:amber` for 14d while we attempt owner outreach; (3) red -> snapshot + rotate/archive after compliance OK. different from prior flows: we create a temp-service-account proxy to avoid outages for known consumers during amber.

nina: sounds safer. can you paste the scanning commands you want us to run? i'll add to nightly job.

lex: cross-cloud snippets i run:
```
# GCP owner-like bindings and KMS annotations
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --flatten="bindings[]" --format='table(bindings.role, bindings.members)' | grep OWNER || true
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format='csv(name,labels)' | grep -E 'none|null' || true

# AWS quick key + policy check
aws kms list-keys --output text --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms describe-key --key-id {} --query 'KeyMetadata.{KeyId:KeyId,Description:Description}'

# Azure keyvault scan
az keyvault key list --vault-name $VAULT --query '[].{name:name,attributes:attributes.enabled}' -o tsv
```

harper: i'll run the scan tonight and upload results. prefer we tag resources with `access:reclaim` rather than deleting labels.

sec-bot: attestation:scan_started ts=3123456789 module=entitlement_tidy scope=org

nina: uploaded results -> gs://redwood-sec/reports/3123456789-entitlement-scan.csv (11 rows). samples: svcacct-dataflow@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com, roles/owner; key-legacy-123,labels=none.

harper: assigned owners in sheet: svcacct-dataflow -> @nina, key-legacy-123 -> @lex. I'll also add a column `temp-proxy` to indicate where we create a proxy SA during amber.

lex: i drafted the reclaim email + self-attest form link (forms.redwood.com/self-attest/entitlement). copy: "You have 72 hours to self-attest ownership of resource X or we will move to amber (console/API disabled) and create a temp-proxy to avoid outages." pls review.

nina: legal wants archive retention text: keep snapshots for 2 years for compliance. cc @compliance-bot to confirm.

compliance-bot: compliance:policy_check status=soft-mandate archive_days=730 note="2yr snapshot retention required for entitlements affecting PII workloads"

harper: i've put terraform gating note in infra: block any PR that adds `roles/owner` without an entry in `infra/owners.yaml` and CODEOWNERS signoff. will open PR.

lex: remediation playbook (short):
- reclaim: add label `access:reclaim`; send self-attest email; create ticket if resource is high-risk.
- amber: disable console/API keys, create proxy SA if resource has active consumers, notify oncall + owners.
- red: take snapshot to gs/aws-archive, rotate keys where applicable, add final `access:archived` label, await retention confirmation before destruction.

sec-bot: attestation:run_complete ts=3123456888 status=partial_orphans=11 report=gs://redwood-sec/reports/3123456888-summary.json

lex: follow-ups: (1) @harper upload proxy SA creation snippet (2) @nina add proof-of-rotation doc to runbook (3) i'll open infra PR for gating and a tiny dashboard alert if amber_count > 5. reconvene in 10 days. :white_check_mark:
